query_text: At a polymer manufacturing plant, an abnormal startup sent an unusually large amount of hot polymer waste into a catch tank. The material foamed and decomposed while retained in the vessel; workers later began opening the vessel, whose cover failed violently and expelled hot plastic. Nearby process tubing also failed and a hot-fluid fire followed. Find comparable incidents involving thermal decomposition, gas generation in process vessels, blocked vents, and opening equipment that may remain pressurized.
source_document_title: BP Amoco Thermal Decomposition Incident

query_text: At a refinery tank farm, contractors were repairing a catwalk near storage tanks containing spent sulfuric acid. A hot-work spark ignited flammable vapors in one tank, causing the tank to separate from its floor and release a very large acid inventory. Other tanks also released material, the fire spread through the area, and acid escaped containment into a nearby river. Find comparable tank-farm incidents involving corrosion, hot work, flammable vapor ignition, and secondary-containment failure.
source_document_title: Motiva Enterprises Sulfuric Acid Tank Explosion

query_text: At a pulp-and-paper mill, highly toxic hydrogen sulfide escaped from a sewer manway while contractors were working nearby. Several people were exposed; two contractors died and additional workers were injured. The event involved wastewater chemistry and work in an area where toxic gas could accumulate or be released without warning. Find comparable H2S poisoning incidents involving industrial sewers, wastewater systems, contractors, and emergency response.
source_document_title: Georgia-Pacific Corp. Hydrogen Sulfide Poisoning

query_text: At a small chemical-products facility in a mixed-use urban building, employees were consolidating hazardous waste from many small containers into larger drums in a confined basement workspace. An explosion and fire injured workers, firefighters, and members of the public, and the building sustained extensive damage. Find comparable waste-mixing incidents involving incompatible chemicals, transfer into larger containers, confined spaces, and consequences to neighboring occupants.
source_document_title: Kaltech Industries Waste Mixing Explosion

query_text: A facility that blended and packaged motor oils, hydraulic oils, and other lubricants experienced a large fire. Firefighters arrived quickly but could not control the incident with the available onsite fire-protection resources. The fire burned for more than a day, consumed a large inventory of combustible and flammable liquids, destroyed the facility, and affected nearby residents. Find comparable bulk-liquid storage or blending fires where inadequate detection, water supply, or suppression allowed a small fire to escalate.
source_document_title: Third Coast Industries Petroleum Products Facility Fire

query_text: At a plating-chemicals manufacturing and research facility, an explosion and fire occurred inside a shared ventilation collection system serving process exhaust. An employee had suspected that a plastic ventilation duct was clogged and struck it; the explosion severely injured the employee and damaged the collection system. The site also stored chemicals that raised concern about possible toxic-gas formation during the emergency. Find comparable incidents involving chemical exhaust ducts, incompatible residues, ventilation-system modifications, and ignition or mechanical disturbance.
source_document_title: Technic Inc. Ventilation System Explosion

query_text: At a chemical manufacturing plant, a process vessel exploded and damaged the facility. The event released a large quantity of aqueous ammonia, requiring nearby residents to evacuate or shelter in place. Find comparable incidents involving catastrophic process-vessel failure, ammonia inventory release, and offsite protective actions.
source_document_title: D.D. Williamson & Co. Catastrophic Vessel Failure

query_text: At an aluminum-wheel manufacturing facility, an aluminum dust explosion and fire occurred in a production area. The dust originated from a scrap remelting system and damaged dust-collection equipment as well as equipment inside the building. Workers were killed or seriously burned. Find comparable combustible-metal or other industrial dust incidents involving dust collection, remelting, accumulation, and ignition.
source_document_title: Hayes Lemmerz Dust Explosions and Fire

query_text: During an attempted first production batch of a specialty chemical at a chemical plant, a runaway reaction released toxic and flammable process chemicals. The release affected the surrounding community, led to an evacuation order, and forced hundreds of families from their homes. Find comparable first-batch or scale-up incidents involving reactive chemistry, loss of temperature control, toxic releases, and community consequences.
source_document_title: MFG Chemical Inc. Toxic Gas Release

query_text: During startup of an alkylation-related refinery unit, a splitter tower became overfilled and pressure-relief devices opened. Flammable liquid discharged from a blowdown stack that did not route the release to a flare; the resulting vapor release ignited and caused major explosions and fires, with many fatalities and injuries. Find comparable refinery startup incidents involving tower overfill, relief-system discharge, blowdown design, and vapor-cloud ignition.
source_document_title: BP America (Texas City) Refinery Explosion

query_text: Industrial painting contractors were applying an epoxy coating inside a long, enclosed hydroelectric penstock tunnel. While workers cleaned application equipment with a flammable solvent in the confined space, a flash fire occurred and rapidly involved additional solvent and combustible coating material. A single exit limited escape, trapping workers and causing multiple fatalities. Find comparable confined-space fires involving flammable cleaning solvents, epoxy coatings, static ignition, contractor work, and rescue limitations.
source_document_title: Xcel Energy Company Hydroelectric Tunnel Fire

query_text: At a specialty-chemical manufacturer, a batch reactor exploded during production of an organometallic fuel additive. Operators had reported a cooling problem shortly before the event. The reaction accelerated uncontrollably, temperature and pressure rose, and the reactor burst, causing a major explosion and chemical fire with fatalities and offsite injuries. Find comparable batch-reactor runaway reactions involving cooling failure, scale-up, thermal instability, and pressure relief.
source_document_title: T2 Laboratories Inc. Reactive Chemical Explosion

query_text: During a transfer operation at a chemical facility, a process tank containing oleum overflowed and filled an exhaust ventilation system. The corrosive fuming sulfuric acid escaped into a storage building, formed an acid-mist cloud, and moved beyond the facility boundary. Emergency responders evacuated or sheltered residents in several nearby towns. Find comparable incidents involving oleum or sulfuric-acid transfer, tank overfill, ventilation-system migration, and community protective actions.
source_document_title: INDSPEC Chemical Corporation Oleum Release

query_text: At an industrial waste-treatment facility, an explosion and fire severely injured several workers and damaged buildings at the site and in the surrounding neighborhood. The event caused damage to multiple nearby residences and businesses. Find comparable incidents involving industrial waste processing, flammable vapor explosions, facility siting, and offsite consequences.
source_document_title: Veolia Environmental Services Flammable Vapor Explosion and Fire

query_text: At a petroleum refinery, a heat exchanger in a naphtha-hydrotreating unit catastrophically ruptured while handling hot hydrocarbon process fluid and hydrogen. A highly flammable release ignited, producing an explosion and intense fire that killed workers nearby. The reported damage mechanism involved high-temperature hydrogen attack in carbon-steel equipment. Find comparable refinery failures involving hydrogen damage, heat-exchanger metallurgy, high-temperature service, and loss of containment.
source_document_title: Tesoro Anacortes Refinery Fatal Explosion and Fire

query_text: At a metal-powder processing facility, an explosion and fire occurred in a production building where titanium and zirconium materials were blended. The investigation identified combustible metal dust and frictional contact inside a blender as important to the ignition sequence. Workers were killed and the facility was heavily damaged. Find comparable combustible-metal dust events involving powder processing, blending equipment, frictional heating, and ignition.
source_document_title: AL Solutions Fatal Dust Explosion

query_text: At a petroleum refinery crude unit, a section of process piping carrying hot light gas oil ruptured and released a large flammable hydrocarbon stream. The liquid partially vaporized into a large cloud that engulfed workers and ignited about two minutes after the release began. Find comparable refinery pipe failures involving corrosion or damage mechanisms, hot hydrocarbon releases, vapor-cloud ignition, and worker/community exposure.
source_document_title: Chevron Richmond Refinery Fire

query_text: At an olefins facility, a propylene fractionator reboiler that had been out of service for an extended period catastrophically ruptured after problems were observed in the quench-water circulation system. Propane and propylene process fluid escaped, ignited, and produced a massive fireball. Find comparable heat-exchanger or reboiler failures involving degraded flow, equipment restart or changeover, and overpressure-protection practices.
source_document_title: Williams Olefins Plant Explosion and Fire

query_text: At a box-manufacturing facility, a steam-system pressure vessel failed catastrophically when its bottom head ruptured. The vessel failure produced a boiling-liquid expanding-vapor explosion, launched the vessel from the building, and caused fatalities both onsite and at a nearby business. The investigation identified corrosion and water-treatment/operating practices as relevant safety issues. Find comparable steam-receiver or pressure-vessel failures involving corrosion, water chemistry, inspection, and BLEVE/projectile hazards.
source_document_title: Loy Lange Box Company Pressure Vessel Explosion

query_text: During a gas-well drilling operation, the crew was tripping drill pipe out of a well when a large influx of gas entered the well. The primary barrier provided by drilling mud and the secondary barrier based on detecting the influx and activating the blowout preventer both failed. The well blew out and the rig caught fire, killing several workers in the driller's cabin. Find comparable well-control incidents involving underbalanced operations, missed influx indicators, barrier failures, and blowout-preventer response.
source_document_title: Pryor Trust Fatal Gas Well Blowout and Fire

query_text: At a specialty-chemical plant, a batch operation involving liquid isobutylene was underway when a small cast-iron Y-strainer in the reactor feed piping broke apart. The resulting flammable vapor cloud exploded, causing a fatality, serious injuries, and many additional worker injuries. Find comparable incidents involving brittle process piping components, flammable gas or liquid feeds to batch reactors, loss of containment, and vapor-cloud ignition.
source_document_title: KMCO LLC Fatal Fire and Explosion

query_text: At a refinery hydrofluoric-acid alkylation unit, an elbow in process piping ruptured and released a large vapor cloud containing mostly propane with a smaller hydrofluoric-acid fraction. The cloud ignited within minutes and caused a major fire followed by several explosions. A rapid acid-deinventory system functioned, but remote mitigation-water pumps failed to start. Find comparable HF alkylation incidents involving piping rupture, toxic/flammable mixed releases, mitigation-system reliability, and vapor-cloud escalation.
source_document_title: Philadelphia Energy Solutions (PES) Refinery Fire and Explosions

query_text: During return to operation of an ethane-cracking furnace after cleaning a coke trap, flammable cracked gas flowed backward into the furnace firebox through an unintended flow path. The gas ignited and exploded, severely damaging the furnace and starting a fire that required nearby employees to evacuate. Find comparable startup and furnace incidents involving backflow, isolation-valve lineups, process-control errors, and ignition in fired equipment.
source_document_title: Shell Polymers Furnace Explosion and Fire

query_text: At a farm using a large propane storage tank to supply heaters, damage to the tank's liquid and vapor piping led to a major propane release. The released liquid rapidly vaporized, ignited, and burned beneath the tank; the tank later exploded in a boiling-liquid expanding-vapor event during the emergency response. Several firefighters and emergency responders were killed or injured. Find comparable LPG storage incidents involving damaged transfer lines, fire exposure of pressure vessels, excess-flow protection, and BLEVE response hazards.
source_document_title: Herrig Brothers Farm Propane Tank Explosion

query_text: At an operating refinery crude unit, maintenance workers were replacing piping connected to a tall fractionator while the process remained online. The line contained naphtha that could not be fully isolated or drained; when workers opened and cut the piping, flammable liquid escaped and ignited on hot process equipment, engulfing workers at different elevations. Find comparable refinery maintenance incidents involving line opening, leaking isolation valves, incomplete draining or depressurization, and hot-surface ignition.
source_document_title: Tosco Avon Refinery Petroleum Naphtha Fire
